outcome: neonatal low Apgar score at birth
cohort: The study included 216 patients who attempted a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) at two tertiary maternity centers.
finding: Failed TOLAC was significantly associated with higher risks of maternal complications such as uterine rupture, ICU admission, and emergency hysterectomy, as well as neonatal complications including low Apgar score, NICU admission, and invasive ventilation.
mod_finding: Compared to successful TOLAC (leading to vaginal birth), failed TOLAC (resulting in emergency cesarean delivery) was associated with significantly higher risks of both maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes.
